7class DatabaseTransactionsManager
8{

13     */

15
16    /**
17     * All of the pending transactions.
18     *

20     */
21    protected $pendingTransactions;
22

25     *
26     * @var array
27     */
28    protected $currentTransaction = [];

30    /**
31     * Create a new database transactions manager instance.
32     */
33    public function __construct()
34    {
35        $this->committedTransactions = new Collection;
36        $this->pendingTransactions = new Collection;
37    }

39    /**
40     * Start a new database transaction.
41     *
42     * @param  string  $connection
43     * @param  int  $level
44     * @return void
45     */
46    public function begin($connection, $level)
47    {
48        $this->pendingTransactions->push(
49            $newTransaction = new DatabaseTransactionRecord(
50                $connection,
51                $level,
52                $this->currentTransaction[$connection] ?? null
53            )
54        );
55
56        $this->currentTransaction[$connection] = $newTransaction;
57    }

59    /**
60     * Commit the root database transaction and execute callbacks.
61     *
62     * @param  string  $connection
63     * @param  int  $levelBeingCommitted
64     * @param  int  $newTransactionLevel
65     * @return array
66     */
67    public function commit($connection, $levelBeingCommitted, $newTransactionLevel)
68    {
69        $this->stageTransactions($connection, $levelBeingCommitted);
70
71        if (isset($this->currentTransaction[$connection])) {
72            $this->currentTransaction[$connection] = $this->currentTransaction[$connection]->parent;
73        }
74
75        if (! $this->afterCommitCallbacksShouldBeExecuted($newTransactionLevel) &&
76            $newTransactionLevel !== 0) {
77            return [];
78        }
79
80        // This method is only called when the root database transaction is committed so there
81        // shouldn't be any pending transactions, but going to clear them here anyways just
82        // in case. This method could be refactored to receive a level in the future too.
83        $this->pendingTransactions = $this->pendingTransactions->reject(
84            fn ($transaction) => $transaction->connection === $connection &&
85                $transaction->level >= $levelBeingCommitted
86        )->values();
87
88        [$forThisConnection, $forOtherConnections] = $this->committedTransactions->partition(
89            fn ($transaction) => $transaction->connection == $connection
90        );
91
92        $this->committedTransactions = $forOtherConnections->values();
93
94        $forThisConnection->map->executeCallbacks();
95
96        return $forThisConnection;
97    }

99    /**
100     * Move relevant pending transactions to a committed state.
101     *
102     * @param  string  $connection
103     * @param  int  $levelBeingCommitted
104     * @return void
105     */
106    public function stageTransactions($connection, $levelBeingCommitted)
107    {
108        $this->committedTransactions = $this->committedTransactions->merge(
109            $this->pendingTransactions->filter(
110                fn ($transaction) => $transaction->connection === $connection &&
111                                     $transaction->level >= $levelBeingCommitted
112            )
113        );
114
115        $this->pendingTransactions = $this->pendingTransactions->reject(
116            fn ($transaction) => $transaction->connection === $connection &&
117                                 $transaction->level >= $levelBeingCommitted
118        );
119    }

121    /**
122     * Rollback the active database transaction.
123     *
124     * @param  string  $connection
125     * @param  int  $newTransactionLevel
126     * @return void
127     */
128    public function rollback($connection, $newTransactionLevel)
129    {
130        if ($newTransactionLevel === 0) {
131            $this->removeAllTransactionsForConnection($connection);
132        } else {
133            $this->pendingTransactions = $this->pendingTransactions->reject(
134                fn ($transaction) => $transaction->connection == $connection &&
135                                     $transaction->level > $newTransactionLevel
136            )->values();
137
138            if ($this->currentTransaction) {
139                do {
140                    $this->removeCommittedTransactionsThatAreChildrenOf($this->currentTransaction[$connection]);
141
142                    $this->currentTransaction[$connection]->executeCallbacksForRollback();
143
144                    $this->currentTransaction[$connection] = $this->currentTransaction[$connection]->parent;
145                } while (
146                    isset($this->currentTransaction[$connection]) &&
147                    $this->currentTransaction[$connection]->level > $newTransactionLevel
148                );
149            }
150        }
151    }

153    /**
154     * Remove all pending, completed, and current transactions for the given connection name.
155     *
156     * @param  string  $connection
157     * @return void
158     */
159    protected function removeAllTransactionsForConnection($connection)
160    {
161        if ($this->currentTransaction) {
162            for ($currentTransaction = $this->currentTransaction[$connection]; isset($currentTransaction); $currentTransaction = $currentTransaction->parent) {
163                $currentTransaction->executeCallbacksForRollback();
164            }
165        }
166
167        $this->currentTransaction[$connection] = null;
168
169        $this->pendingTransactions = $this->pendingTransactions->reject(
170            fn ($transaction) => $transaction->connection == $connection
171        )->values();
172
173        $this->committedTransactions = $this->committedTransactions->reject(
174            fn ($transaction) => $transaction->connection == $connection
175        )->values();
176    }

178    /**
179     * Remove all transactions that are children of the given transaction.
180     *
181     * @param  \Illuminate\Database\DatabaseTransactionRecord  $transaction
182     * @return void
183     */
184    protected function removeCommittedTransactionsThatAreChildrenOf(DatabaseTransactionRecord $transaction)
185    {
186        [$removedTransactions, $this->committedTransactions] = $this->committedTransactions->partition(
187            fn ($committed) => $committed->connection == $transaction->connection &&
188                               $committed->parent === $transaction
189        );
190
191        // There may be multiple deeply nested transactions that have already committed that we
192        // also need to remove. We will recurse down the children of all removed transaction
193        // instances until there are no more deeply nested child transactions for removal.
194        $removedTransactions->each(
195            fn ($transaction) => $this->removeCommittedTransactionsThatAreChildrenOf($transaction)
196        );
197    }
